newsitem.title: UK: Commercial Union tumbles after results.
newsitem.headline: Commercial Union tumbles after results.

text.p: Shares in Commercial Union Plc tumbled on Wednesday to a six-and-a-half week low after the insurer reported its results for the year.
AT 0922 GMT, the shares were down 17-1/2p to 672-1/2.
The group's annual pre-tax profits of 444 million stg were slightly above analysts' forecast, but the steep six percent drop in its net asset value depressed shares, dealers and analysts said..

"The decline in the NAV (net asset value) was largely due to currency and while people knew the sterling would affect the NAV, I don't think anyone thought the impact would be that great," said one analyst. --London newsroom +44 171 542 5106
